about: A fake Amazon S3 storage server for running tests locally.

prs.title: Partial downloads work with current AWS tools
prs.broken: Current AWS tools send a checksum with every upload. The fake server sent it back on partial downloads too, so the tools checked a piece against the whole file and failed. Big downloads broke the same way.
prs.changed: I made partial downloads leave out the whole-file checksum, as real S3 does.
prs.matters: Tests using current AWS tools against the fake server pass again.

prs.title: File metadata names come back in lowercase, as on S3
prs.broken: Custom metadata on stored files came back with capitalized names, so code that works against Amazon S3 failed with missing-key errors in tests.
prs.changed: Metadata header names are now sent in lowercase in every storage backend.
prs.matters: Tests against this fake S3 behave like the real service.
